messages:
maria: Heads-up: during the mobile responsive pass i noticed the progress strip (passed/failed/pending counts) collapses into an icon-only toolbar and loses its accessible label. keyboard users and SR users can't discover counts on small screens. anyone seen this?

sam: yep saw that on my phone. it's compacting using CSS that hides the text nodes. probably `display:none` on `.count-label` under 480px.

maria: that's the issue. mobile shouldn't hide the semantic label. we can visually compress but keep the label visually-hidden for assistive tech.

olivia: suggested pattern: keep the full text but visually clip it with `.sr-only` class instead of display:none. then update `aria-label` on each count button like `aria-label=\"3 checks passed\"`. also ensure the counts are announced when they change via `aria-live=\"polite\"`.

sam: technical: makes sense. current animation flips the layout and re-inserts elements which causes SRs to re-announce stale content. we should update in place instead of re-creating nodes. also debounce updates to reduce chatter.

jeff: design question: do we still want the mini-strip at the top on mobile, or should we move it inline under the step heading? i worry about top-toolbar real estate.

maria: prefer inline under heading so it's in the logical flow. keeps tab order predictable.

kyle: small copy tweak: we're using icons with colored dots and no alt text. for colorblind users, add shape or text fallback. e.g., green check icon + text \"passed\". don't rely on color alone.

olivia: accessibility rule: never use color as the only status indicator. aria-label + inner text is best. and ensure contrast: the dot + number must meet 4.5:1 for body text or use larger type.

sam: runtime note: SSE payload already includes counts in `summary` updates. frontend can map that to `#progress-strip` innerText and update `aria-live` region. sample update handler:
```js
// on SSE message
const summary = payload.summary;
progressStrip.querySelector('.passed .count').textContent = summary.passed;
progressStrip.querySelector('.failed .count').textContent = summary.failed;
// update visually-hidden label for announcement
progressStrip.setAttribute('aria-label', `Network checks: ${summary.passed} passed, ${summary.failed} failed, ${summary.pending} pending`);
```

maria: nice. QA note: when counts change, screen readers should hear one succinct announcement, not multiple. debounce at 200-300ms fine.

jeff: keyboard shortcut ask: could we allow `g` to jump to the progress strip from anywhere in the wizard? ops liked `h` previously. want to standardize.

olivia: if we add a global shortcut, expose it in the keyboard help modal and make it opt-out friendly. also ensure it doesn't conflict with browser or OS shortcuts. intercept only when focus is inside our app shell.

kyle: another mobile-specific issue: expanded probe details open as a full-screen sheet and trap focus in iOS VoiceOver. we should implement `aria-modal` on the sheet and ensure `inert` on background content, plus provide an explicit "Close details" control in the top-left.

sam: implement `inert` polyfill for browsers that don't support it. avoid focus() calls before the element is in DOM — race conditions on iOS cause focus to fail.

qa-bot: reminder: please add a regression test in cypress for keyboard tab order and an axe run for the mobile breakpoint.

maria: action items: i'll move strip inline under heading and update figma (mobile frames). jeff please pick the standard shortcut and update docs. olivia to write the aria/snippet for sr-only and modal behavior. sam to implement in-place updates + debounce + inert polyfill. kyle to update copy for color+shape indicators. qa-bot to add tests.

jeff: i'll pick `g` for "go to summary" (sounds intuitive) and add to help modal. we'll trial in the QA session tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar: :+1:

maria: thanks team — will upload new frames and a short screen recording of VoiceOver + keyboard walkthrough by EOD. :rocket:
